company.name: Lightspark
company.shortDescription: Builds payments infrastructure for digital banks, wallets and exchanges, real-time global money movement for Bitcoin, fiat, and stablecoins.
company.description: The world’s financial system is stuck in the past—slow, costly, and fragmented. Businesses need a better way to move money: fast, open, and always on. Lightspark makes it happen. We connect businesses to a global payments network built on Bitcoin’s open, decentralized foundation so that today’s financial systems can link to next-generation technology and make money move like information on the Internet: instantly, securely, and at a fraction of today’s costs. Lightspark’s infrastructure unlocks seamless, low-cost, and reliable payments across borders—with no gatekeepers, no delays, and no hidden fees.
